extracted_factors.Label: Increase in Nickel Production
extracted_factors.Description: The substantial rise in nickel production influences deforestation and environmental degradation, contributing directly to changes in ecosystems.

extracted_factors.Label: Deforestation
extracted_factors.Description: Nickel mining activities have led to significant deforestation, reducing forest cover and biodiversity in Indonesia.

extracted_factors.Label: Environmental Pollution
extracted_factors.Description: Increased mining activity has resulted in air and water pollution, affecting soil and human health.

extracted_factors.Label: Global Demand for Nickel
extracted_factors.Description: The rising demand for nickel, especially for electric vehicle batteries, influences the mining activities in Indonesia resulting in higher environmental stress.

extracted_factors.Label: Regulatory Framework
extracted_factors.Description: National and local regulations shape the extent and manner of nickel mining operations.

extracted_factors.Label: Health Issues from Pollution
extracted_factors.Description: Air pollution from mining activities is causing respiratory and other health issues in nearby communities.

extracted_factors.Label: Biodiversity Loss
extracted_factors.Description: Increase in nickel mining activities is leading to habitat degradation and biodiversity loss, affecting flora and fauna.

extracted_factors.Label: Infrastructure Development and Economic Growth
extracted_factors.Description: Mining contributes to infrastructure development and economic growth but at environmental and social costs.
